html:
Vietnam, an S-shaped country, often likened to a dragon, is located in the west of the East Sea. The perfect combination of elegance and rustic charm always captivates travelers with rich experiences, beautiful landscapes and hospitable people who seem to want to hold travelers’ footsteps.

Sightseeing Highlights

  • Visit Ho Chi Minh City landmarks such as: War Remnants Museum, Notre Dame Cathedral, Reunification Palace and the former US Embassy….

  • Explore the legendary Cu Chi tunnels.

  • Explore Cai Rang Floating Market and visit handicraft villages in the Mekong Delta.

  • Take a walking of Hoi An Ancient town, get some cloth made at the local tailor shops.

  • Discover the Imperial Citadel and the Emperor Mausoleums in Hue.

  • Take a cyclo (rickshaw) through the French Quarter, Stroll around Hanoi’s Old Quarter and Hoan Kiem Lake.Row a boat through the lakes and admire the limestone mountains of Ninh Binh.

  • Spend a night onboard an overnight cruise in Ha Long Bay.

Dining Experience

  • 10 hotel buffet breakfasts.
  • 2 dinners and 7 lunches at well-selected restaurants.
  • 1 Cooking demonstration on Halong Bay boat

What’s Included?

  • Private English-speaking guide, accommodation, private tours and transfer, domestic flights, A/C vehicles, some main meals, all entrance fees, tax, and service charge.

What’s Not Included?

  • Your international flights from and to Vietnam, entry visa to Vietnam, personal expense, tips to guide and driver.
outline: Day 1: Arrival in Ho Chi Minh City
Day 2: HCM City – Cu Chi tunnels & City Sightseeing
Day 3: HCM City – Mekong Delta (Ben Tre & Can Tho)
Day 4: Can Tho – Cai Rang Floating Market – Flight to Da Nang/ Hoi An
Day 5: Hoi An – Walking & Food Tour
Day 8: Hanoi – Full day City Tour & Local food discovery
